description: Sector Activity Index: monthly diffusion readings (50 = as many firms report rising as falling; computed as 50 + survey balance/2 from European Commission business surveys, NACE-2 subsectors grouped into 22 sectors with value-added weights) for the euro area (EA), the EU and European countries. Measures: out (output, past 3 months), new (new business), emp (employment expectations), fut (future activity), px (prices charged expectations). Omit sector for a ranking of all sectors in one geography; give a sector name for its monthly history.

geo.description: EC country code: EA (euro area, default), EU, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, PL, AT, BE, SE, IE, EL (Greece), PT, FI, CZ, HU, RO, TR, ...

months.description: Months of history when a sector is given (latest last)

sector.description: Sector name or fragment, e.g. 'Chemicals', 'Software', 'Autos', 'Banks', 'all' for the all-sector composite; omit for the ranking

name: get_sectors
